questions.explanation: The header fields support reliability and flow control: sequence numbers order bytes, acknowledgement numbers report what arrived, the window advertises receive capacity, and flags signal connection setup and teardown. IP addresses live in the enclosing IP header, and link addresses live in the frame, so each layer contributes its own control information. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
questions.hint: Ask which fields let a receiver report what it has received.
